security_justification.audit_integrity: Faulty host capabilities cannot produce an event delivered to the sink; existing validation and operation evidence remain authoritative.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization evaluation changes. Provider exceptions become bounded results rather than misattributed caller failures.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Same-instance operation evidence and branded context remain unchanged; lifecycle and operation authority resolution still precede context provider invocation.
security_justification.concurrency: Preserve shutdown single-flight, event reservations and at-most-once sink lifecycle calls; timer fault tracking does not introduce a second drain.
security_justification.confidentiality: Provider error objects, messages and extra schema failure fields never cross the result boundary; only bounded diagnostics remain.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm or identifier policy changes. Existing provider-generated identifiers retain validation and retention checks.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Catch without inspecting thrown values; rebuild known-code valid-category schema failures with bounded string paths and no extra fields.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Node provider runtime and collector remain untouched; Node error catalog documents the core provider diagnostics only.
security_justification.fail_posture: An unarmed timer fails closed immediately, without sink lifecycle calls or unbounded draining; non-results cannot bypass schema validation.
security_justification.lifecycle: Every shutdown outcome reaches shut_down; unref and cleanup faults preserve earlier timeout or sink failures and later calls remain refused.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: No caller mutation establishes operation evidence. Existing mutation anchors remain exact and their unchanged verification suites must pass.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Transformation-hook and sink failure contracts remain intact; schema error sanitization drops provider-controlled extra fields.
security_justification.resource_retention: No new retention store or capacity change. Shutdown cancellation is contained and the existing deadline bounds in-flight waiting.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Redelivery does not invoke identifiers or clock. Named runtime selection and retry identity anchors remain unchanged; #816 is excluded.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Provider faults are attributed to fixed host capabilities, never caller input. Caller throwing getters keep SDK_INVALID_INPUT semantics.
